notes: m holds ADMIN on r (granted by the applier) and has granted r onward to n. Desired: m loses ADMIN, n keeps r. Postgres refuses REVOKE ADMIN OPTION FOR r FROM m (dependent privileges exist); main renders that REVOKE and fails loudly. The PoC renders GRANT r TO m WITH ADMIN FALSE ... GRANTED BY applier, which Postgres accepts without a dependency check, leaving n's row granted by a role with no ADMIN.
